 Shri Shankar Dayal Mishra - Advocate for appellant.

entities.text:
High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Jabalpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Shri Anubhav Jain - Public Prosecutor for respondent/S
Heard on Ia No.10936 of 2022.

2.  This is the first application seeking for suspension of sentence and bail filed on behalf of appellant/accused Basant Lal Kol, who has been convicted under Section 5(tha)6 of the Protection of Children From Sexual Offences Act, 2012 and sentenced to R.I. for 20 years and fine of Rs.1,000/-, with default stipulation.

entities.text: Protection of Children From Sexual Offences Act, 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
He has also been convicted under Sections 363 and 366 of the Indian Penal Code and sentence to R.I. for 5 years and fine of Rs.500/- and R.I. for 7 years and fine of Rs.500/- respectively, with default stipulations vide judgment dated 03.02.2022 passed by the Special Judge (POCSO) Mauganj, Rewa in Special Case No.8 of 2019.
3.
The case of the prosecution is that a complaint was lodged on 03.09.2018 that daughter of the complainant is missing since 31.08.2018.
A case was registered against the accused and he has been convicted and sentenced as indicated hereinabove.
4. The plea of the accused herein is that there is no question of kidnapping the victim or having committed the offence under Section 376 of the Indian Penal Code against her.
Both of them stayed together for almost a period of 12 days in Allahabad and no efforts were made by the victim to save herself and, therefore, the accused is entitled for bail.
5. Keeping in mind the fact that the victim has stayed with the accused for a period of 12 days and no efforts were made by her to save herself, I.A.No.10936 of 2022 is allowed.

6. Subject to deposit of the fine amount, the remaining jail sentence of the appellant shall remain suspended and appellant/accused Basant Lal Kol is directed to be enlarged on bail on he furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court for his appearance before the trial Court/concerned Court on 08.01.2024 and thereafter on such other subsequent dates as may be Basant Lal Kol vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 18 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/20826423/
1 fixed in that behalf.
